title: Outcome law and cost of the derandomized BLR program
statement: Let $n,r\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $s:\{0,1\}^r\to\mathbb{F}_2^n$ be a seed map. When the derandomized BLR program runs with target $f$, its joint law of output and cost is the law obtained by choosing independent uniform bit vectors $u\in\{0,1\}^n$ and $v\in\{0,1\}^r$, returning the BLR test result on the corresponding cube point and seed point, and assigning cost $(0,3,n+r+(2n+1)+3)$ (random examples, queries, and local work, respectively).
hypotheses_covered: Boolean target function on the sign cube
Seed map from $r$ bits to the $n$-dimensional binary cube
